title: Four Channels Gone In 3 Days
caption:
His posting bot tried too hard. Meta killed all four channels in three days.

Patrick Schoenmaker's autopilot posted too often and retried the instant anything failed. Session invalidated, two days of silence, and everything after 12:22 failing quietly while his dashboard showed green.

He didn't make it smarter, he made it slower — 180 minutes between posts, no auto-retry, a stop that asks a human. I've shipped that same retry loop; backoff is the unglamorous fix I keep skipping.

Slower or smarter?

slides.headline:
Four Channels
Gone In 3 Days
slides.sub: Meta invalidated the session on Aug 4. The cause was his own posting bot.

slides.headline: It Retried Every Failure
slides.sub: Too many posts across three days, and it fired again the instant one failed. Meta's answer: reconnect and wait one to two days.

slides.headline:
The Dashboard
Said Green
slides.sub: Everything after 12:22 failed quietly. His own panel showed green three times while nothing was live.

slides.title:
Three Brakes,
Not More Brains
items: 180 minutes minimum between two posts, across every project.
One project per run. No fanning out across channels at once.
No automatic retry. A failure stops the autopilot and asks a human.

slides.title: Ask The Platform
slides.sub: The dashboard stopped answering from memory. Now it asks Meta whether the post is really there.

slides.headline: Slower Beat Smarter
slides.sub: and I'll send the three brakes
